reason: At 23 euros a litre it costs three or four times what my own house syrups cost me in fruit and sugar, and more than double a Monin bottle. I'll ask for the free sample out of curiosity, but I can't put that on the quarterly cost sheet without it pushing up the price of every cocktail.
objection: I already make my own syrups and rhums arrangés with local fruit for a few euros a litre. Fermented is interesting, but I don't see why my customers would pay more for a drink because of it, so it just eats my margin.
would_change_my_mind: A price near 12 euros a litre, or proof from a tasting that a Koso signature cocktail sells at a higher menu price so the cost per glass pays for itself.
